verdict.next_action: Calm DECIDE at 09:32 ET is still pending; re-record the baseline within 24h

the_measurement_that_made_this_necessary.taken: before any code was written, against the live B1 record
the_measurement_that_made_this_necessary.conclusion: B1's freshness window is about POSITIONS AND ORDERS, and a reset changes neither — so the record went on vouching for an account that no longer existed and nothing in it could have said so

books_were_genuinely_flat.note: flatness was never the problem; identity was

why_get_equity_could_not_close_it.docstring: Accept any currency (CAD/USD/BASE accounts all work)
why_get_equity_could_not_close_it.behaviour: prefers a BASE figure, then whichever of USD or CAD the broker lists first, then anything at all; returns a bare float
why_get_equity_could_not_close_it.consequence: a baseline built on it would record 'equity 250000' for an account holding 250,000 CAD and nobody could tell afterwards
why_get_equity_could_not_close_it.what_the_probe_does_instead: reads accountValues() and keeps EVERY currency-tagged NetLiquidation, with the label attached to the number all the way into the record

broker_reconcile.detail: USD 250,817.91, no positions, no working orders, both books flat and route-stamped, read 0 minute(s) ago

contract.why_warn_also_refuses: the difference between WARN and FAIL is what an operator does next, not what the gate does; a gate with a maybe in it is a gate somebody argues with
contract.pass_band_rationale: 5% of 250,000 is 12,500 — wide enough for fees and marks, narrow enough that a mis-funded account cannot hide in it
contract.fail_band_rationale: 25% is 62,500; the reading that prompted this module was 299% away

where_it_lives.why: a baseline that lives only in a report is a baseline the gate cannot read
where_it_lives.why_append: a record that overwrote its predecessor would make 'when did this account last look right' unanswerable
where_it_lives.attribution_in_every_row: zero positions is attributable to every route; a non-zero count is attributable to none

readiness.b1_note: still an operator decision plus a measurement; it can cite fresher account evidence, but nothing here signs it and nothing auto-creates a retirement confirmation

verified_against_the_running_process.served_line: Paper account baseline: USD 250,818 — broker reconcile flat

an_inference_i_nearly_reported_as_fact.what: from file mtimes I concluded the running backend could not be serving the new block
an_inference_i_nearly_reported_as_fact.why_it_looked_true: the scheduler and backend were restarted at 07:08 ET by the operator, and every file this stage touched was written 16-18 minutes after
an_inference_i_nearly_reported_as_fact.what_the_measurement_said: asking the endpoint directly returned the new block, correctly populated
an_inference_i_nearly_reported_as_fact.lesson: an inference from file times is not a measurement of a process — the stage two before this one says so in its own words

restart_that_had_already_happened.by: the operator, through ops.py (ops.log records kill_then_start on 5856)
restart_that_had_already_happened.means: the restart Stages 5ZZC and 5ZZD were both waiting for is done and both are live

defects_found_in_my_own_code.what: operator_line crashed on a PASS record with no account block
defects_found_in_my_own_code.how: it formatted the equity unconditionally and raised TypeError
defects_found_in_my_own_code.consequence: would have taken the whole readiness call down — a reporting function that can crash turns a mild problem into no report at all
defects_found_in_my_own_code.found_by: a mutation test, not by reading

defects_found_in_my_own_code.what: MAX_RECORD_AGE_HOURS looked like a setting and was not
defects_found_in_my_own_code.how: written into latest()'s signature as a default argument, evaluated once at definition, so patching the module constant changed nothing
defects_found_in_my_own_code.consequence: a stale record still read back as a PASS
defects_found_in_my_own_code.found_by: the mutation that patched it and watched the test stay green
